test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on function arguments to verify child lifetime is extended by parent
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to verify returned child stays alive with parent
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection of circular references involving ParentGC objects with keep_alive children
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructors to verify child argument lifetime is tied to parent
test_call_guard: test pybind11 call_guard policies including GIL release and multiple guard ordering behavior
